title: SSM Connect portable connection profile
description: Portable interchange format for a connection profile (specification section 6.1). Each client MAY keep its own native storage; both MUST be able to export and import this document. Unknown optional properties are permitted and SHOULD be preserved on round-trip.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this document format. A client that does not support the value MUST fail with an actionable message rather than guess.

id.description: Stable profile identity, preserved across export and import.

ssoStartUrl.description: AWS IAM Identity Center start URL, for example https://d-xxxx.awsapps.com/start.

ssoRegion.description: Region for SSOOIDC and SSO:GetRoleCredentials. Distinct from resourceRegion.

accountId.description: AWS account ID. See the 'deliberate tightenings' note in contracts/README.md.

roleName.description: IAM Identity Center permission-set role name.

resourceRegion.description: Region for EC2, SSM, and Secrets Manager operations.

instanceTagKey.description: EC2 tag key used to resolve the workstation.

instanceTagValue.description: EC2 tag value. May be empty in a not-yet-configured profile; a profile is only connectable when this is non-empty.

connectMode.description: Absent or null MUST resolve to singleUser, so profiles written before this field existed keep working.

connectAction.description: What to launch once the tunnel is up. v1 implements the DCV Viewer auto-login path only.

localPort.description: Local loopback port the tunnel binds.

remotePort.description: Remote DCV port forwarded over the tunnel.

agentRemotePort.description: Multi-user only. Port the on-box agent listens on. Absent or null MUST resolve to 8444.

secretId.description: Single-user only. Secrets Manager secret ID holding the DCV password. This is an identifier, never the secret value.

preferences.description: Non-secret client preferences supported on both platforms.

autoConnect.description: Connect automatically at application launch, only when the profile is fully configured.

autoReconnect.description: Re-establish the tunnel automatically if it drops unexpectedly.

clipboardAutoClearSeconds.description: Seconds before the clipboard clears after copying the DCV password. 0 disables auto-clear.

allOf.$comment: Security boundary, specification sections 6.1 and 12: the portable document carries identifiers and preferences only. It MUST NOT carry live authentication material or machine-local paths.
A multi-user host is identity-only: there is no shared-password fallback, so a secret ID on a multi-user profile indicates a mistake rather than a fallback.

awsRegion.$comment: Byte-for-byte the rule the AWS SDK endpoint resolver applies. Kept identical so a profile is rejected with an actionable message before any SDK call rather than surfacing an opaque client error. Leading or trailing whitespace makes a region invalid.
